accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: The Azure Storage Queue account name.

queueName.title: Queue Name
queueName.description: The Azure Storage Queue container name.

accessKey.title: Access Key
accessKey.description: The Azure Storage Queue access key.

maxMessages.title: Maximum Messages
maxMessages.description: The maximum number of messages to get. You can specify a value between 1 and 32. The default is 1 (one message). If there are fewer than the maximum number of messages in the queue, then all the messages are returned.

credentialType.title: Credential Type
credentialType.description: Determines the credential strategy to adopt.
